## History

Twenty years prior, Sarah wanted to marry Luther Wallace, but her father sent him away because Luther was poor. For years, her sister Martha required her to whitewash an old duckhouse every spring, refusing to throw it out. Sarah later rescued [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) when [Anne](../character/anne.md) fell through the roof of the duckhouse while trying to look for a willow-ware platter. After rescuing her, Sarah hosted [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) for tea, negotiated the sale of the platter to [Anne](../character/anne.md), and shared the news that she was getting married.

_Sources: [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P2](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0002), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P4](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0004), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P5](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0005), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P6](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0006), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P7](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0007), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P8](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0008), +24 more_
